Thus H^3(Q)(1) has cyclotomic characteristic polynomial Phi_61 and dimension one over K=Q(zeta61). The Hodge decomposition over L is five copies of the rank-one L CM Hodge structure; classical CM theory gives a simple sixfold A and J~_C A^5, End^0(J)~M_5(L), rational dimension 300. The conclusion is an unpolarized isogeny classification only.
